aibatcheditor-desc: Batch-edit pages with AI assistance for wikilinks, spellcheck, formatting, and writing style, with preview-before-save.
aibatcheditor-privacy-notice: Drafting sends each page's wikitext and your instructions to the configured AI provider (for example xAI Grok). Use this tool only on content you are allowed to share with that service.
aibatcheditor-summary: Select pages and AI operations, preview each change as a diff, then approve before saving.
aibatcheditor-permission-denied: You do not have permission to use the AI Batch Editor. The "$1" right is required.
aibatcheditor-nojs: The AI Batch Editor requires JavaScript to be enabled.
right-aibatchedit: Use the AI Batch Editor to run AI-assisted batch edits
aibatcheditor-error-no-input: Provide a list of titles, a category name, or a template name.
aibatcheditor-error-no-titles: No pages were found for the given input.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-too-large: The batch contains $1 pages, but the maximum allowed is $2.
aibatcheditor-error-operation-disabled: The operation "$1" is disabled on this wiki.
aibatcheditor-error-template-page-not-fo: Template "$1" was not found on this wiki.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-not-configured: The AI endpoint is not configured. Set $wgAIBatchEditorApiUrl and $wgAIBatchEditorApiKey in LocalSettings.php.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-invalid-response: The AI returned an invalid response.
aibatcheditor-error-llm-empty-response: The AI returned an empty response.
aibatcheditor-error-rate-limit: Hourly AI limit reached ($2 of $1 requests used). Try again later.
aibatcheditor-error-custom-needs-instruc: The custom operation requires AI instructions.
aibatcheditor-error-templates-needs-name: The templates operation requires at least one template name.
aibatcheditor-error-templates-too-many: Too many templates in one batch (maximum is 5).
aibatcheditor-error-template-not-found: A reference template was not found on the source wiki.
aibatcheditor-error-template-source-inva: The template source wiki URL is invalid. Use an HTTPS URL.
aibatcheditor-error-template-source-not-: The template source wiki is not on the allowed host list.
aibatcheditor-error-template-fetch-faile: Could not fetch template source from the remote wiki.
aibatcheditor-error-template-too-large: A reference template exceeds the configured size limit.
aibatcheditor-error-page-too-large: Page is too large for AI processing ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-instructions-too-lon: AI instructions are too long ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-diff-too-large: Diff text exceeds the maximum allowed size ($1 bytes per side).
aibatcheditor-error-edits-payload-too-la: The submitted edits payload is too large ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-save-proposed-too-la: Proposed wikitext is too large ($1 bytes; limit is $2).
aibatcheditor-error-api-http: The request to the wiki server failed. Check your connection and try again.
aibatcheditor-error-api-timeout: The request to the wiki server timed out. Try again with a smaller batch.
aibatcheditor-error-api-empty: The wiki server returned an empty response. Try again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-wikitext: Cannot save: the page does not use wikitext.
aibatcheditor-ui-page-instructions-place: Override batch instructions for this page
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-summary: Validate and list pages for AI batch editing.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-param-titles: Pipe- or newline-separated list of page titles.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-param-template: Template name (with or without the Template: prefix or braces). Lists pages that transclude it.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-param-prefix: Optional title prefix filter when listing category or template members.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-example-2: List pages in a category with a title prefix.
apihelp-aibatcheditorlist-example-3: List pages that transclude a template, filtered by title prefix.
apihelp-aibatcheditorpreview-summary: Build and return LLM prompts for one page without calling the AI.
apihelp-aibatcheditorpreview-example-1: Preview prompts for a custom operation on the main page.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-pages-desc: Enter page titles, choose a category, or search by template transclusion, then validate which pages are editable.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-operation-desc: Choose an operation, aggressiveness profile, and the edit summary used when saving.
aibatcheditor-ui-step-results-desc: Preview each proposed change, approve the ones you want, then save them to the wiki.
aibatcheditor-ui-titles-placeholder: One title per line, or separated by |
aibatcheditor-ui-titles-help: One title per line, or separated by |.
aibatcheditor-ui-template-help: List pages on this wiki that transclude this template.
aibatcheditor-ui-prefix-help: Only include pages whose title starts with this prefix.
aibatcheditor-ui-templates-help: Template names to fetch from the source wiki and use as reference. One per line or separated by |. Example: Ficha clones https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plantilla:Ficha.
aibatcheditor-ui-templatesource-help: HTTPS base URL of the wiki to clone templates from. Defaults to the wiki configured by the administrator.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-help: How much to change within the operation scope.
aibatcheditor-ui-profile-custom-fixed: Custom uses balanced intensity. Control scope and depth via AI instructions.
aibatcheditor-ui-instructions-placeholde: e.g. Add this date as married couple on each page
aibatcheditor-ui-instructions-help: Custom directions sent to the AI for every page in the batch. This is not the wiki edit summary.
aibatcheditor-ui-summary-placeholder: Describe this batch edit for the page history
aibatcheditor-ui-summary-help: Recorded in the wiki history when you save approved changes.
aibatcheditor-ui-no-valid-pages: No editable pages were found for this input.
aibatcheditor-ui-cancel-batch-confirm: Cancel the running batch? Pages still processing will stop; finished results are kept.
aibatcheditor-ui-too-large-skipped: $1 {{PLURAL:$1|page|pages}} skipped because they exceed the size limit ($2 bytes).
aibatcheditor-page-error-too-large: Too large for AI ($1 bytes; limit $2)
aibatcheditor-page-error-not-readable: You do not have permission to read this page
aibatcheditor-error-preview-needs-title: Select at least one valid page title to preview the prompt.
aibatcheditor-ui-preview-prompt-notice: Debug preview of the prompt sent to the AI. Enable with $wgAIBatchEditorPromptPreview = true only while troubleshooting.
apihelp-aibatcheditordiff-summary: Render a wikitext diff for batch preview.
apihelp-aibatcheditordiff-param-title: Optional page title for diff headers.
apihelp-aibatcheditordiff-example-1: Render a diff between two wikitext strings.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-exists: Cannot save: page does not exist.
aibatcheditor-error-save-redirect: Cannot save: page is a redirect.
aibatcheditor-error-save-not-editable: Cannot save: you do not have permission to edit this page.
aibatcheditor-error-save-conflict: Cannot save: the page was edited by someone else. Re-run the batch and try again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-missing-summary: Provide an edit summary before saving.
aibatcheditor-error-save-no-edits: No edits were submitted to save.
aibatcheditor-error-save-invalid-json: The submitted edits payload is not valid.
aibatcheditor-error-save-invalid-draft-t: Cannot save: the draft token is missing, expired, or does not match this proposal. Re-run the batch and try again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-draft-token-bad: Cannot save: the draft token signature is invalid. Try saving again; if it persists, contact an administrator.
aibatcheditor-error-save-draft-token-con: Cannot save: the proposed text no longer matches the approved draft. Re-run the batch and try again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-draft-token-exp: Cannot save: the draft token has expired. Try saving again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-draft-token-rev: Cannot save: the draft token does not match the page revision. Re-run the batch and try again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-draft-token-tit: Cannot save: the draft token does not match the page title. Re-run the batch and try again.
aibatcheditor-error-save-draft-token-use: Cannot save: the draft token was issued to another user. Re-run the batch while signed in as the same user.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-missing-id: Provide a batch ID to poll.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-not-found: Batch not found or it has expired. Start a new batch run.
aibatcheditor-error-batch-invalid-page-i: Page-specific instructions must be a JSON object mapping titles to instruction text.
apihelp-aibatcheditorbatchadvance-summar: Process the next chunk of a server-side AI batch run.
apihelp-aibatcheditorbatchadvance-exampl: Advance a batch run by one chunk.
apihelp-aibatcheditorbatchcancel-summary: Cancel a running server-side AI batch run.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-all-confirm: Approve AI-proposed changes for $1 {{PLURAL:$1|page|pages}}? Review each diff before saving.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-without-diff-co: Approve this change without previewing the diff?
aibatcheditor-ui-save-without-diff-confi: Save $1 approved {{PLURAL:$1|change|changes}} without previewing the diff?
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-major-deletion: This proposal removes a large share of the page content.
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-near-empty: This proposal leaves almost no content on the page.
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-large-growth: This proposal adds a large amount of new content.
aibatcheditor-ui-warning-section-removed: This proposal removes one or more section headings.
aibatcheditor-ui-approve-with-warnings-c: Approve this change despite the risk warnings?
aibatcheditor-ui-draft-notice: Draft will run $1 {{PLURAL:$1|AI request|AI requests}} (one per page). Hourly limit: $2 of $3 remaining.
aibatcheditor-ui-draft-notice-insufficie: This batch needs $1 {{PLURAL:$1|AI request|AI requests}}, but only $2 of $3 hourly requests remain. Reduce the page list or wait for the limit to reset.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-refresh-failed: Could not refresh draft tokens before save. Re-run the batch and try again.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-refresh-partial: Saving $1 of $2 approved changes; some pages could not be refreshed.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-none-selected: Select at least one change to save.
aibatcheditor-ui-save-summary-required: Enter an edit summary before saving.

apihelp-aibatcheditorsave-example-1: Save one approved edit with a summary.
